title: Fee Income to Support Citizens Financial's Q3 Earnings Amid Lower NII
description: Citizens Financial Group's Q3 earnings are expected to decline due to lower net interest income, but fee income is likely to provide support. The company's lending book may have been positively impacted by improvement in commercial loans, while subdued real estate loan demand could offset growth. Non-interest income is expected to rise, driven by higher mortgage banking fees and trust and investment services fees.

title: HSBC Plans to Expand Private Wealth Management Business in Canada
description: HSBC plans to double the size of its Canadian private client business over the next few years, capitalizing on Canada's reputation for socioeconomic stability and growing pool of high-net-worth individuals. The bank aims to expand its private wealth management hubs and attract international clients, including new immigrants and those looking to invest in Canada.

title: US Banks Plan Sharp Cuts In Corporate Deposit Returns As Fed Lowers Interest Rates: Could Financial Stocks Take A Hit?
description: U.S. banks are preparing to slash interest payments on corporate deposits as the Federal Reserve's recent rate cuts take effect. This trend is likely to continue, with projections indicating that the Fed's rates could fall from 5% to around 3% by 2026. While this may help larger banks maintain profitability, smaller and mid-sized banks could face pressure on their profit margins to keep depositors satisfied.
